bagPolicy.summary: Only small purses and fanny packs up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches may enter; backpacks and larger bags are prohibited.
allowed: Small purse or fanny pack up to 12 × 12 × 6 inches
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The theater recommends the two public garages on Lafayette within one block on either side of Fourth Street. They often charge a flat fee after 5 p.m.; the theater has no valet.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
